title: 代词
goal: 能根据句法位置和指代关系选择代词。

points.label: 根据句法位置与指代关系选择代词形式
判断形式代词及不定代词的用法

body.p: 代词代替名词或名词短语。选代词分两步：先确定所指对象的人称和数，再看代词在句中的位置，选主格、宾格或物主形式。

body.box: Mia found her key. She put it in her bag.

body.p: she 指 Mia，her 修饰名词，it 指钥匙。代词 it 还可作形式主语或形式宾语。

cards.title: 人称与物主代词
rows: The note is for me. / My note is here. / The note is mine.
The ticket is for you. / Your ticket is here. / The ticket is yours.
The map is for him. / His map is here. / The map is his.
The bag is for her. / Her bag is here. / The bag is hers.
Read it. / Its label is clear.
The table is for us. / Our table is here. / The table is ours.
The room is for them. / Their room is here. / The room is theirs.

cards.title: 反身代词
cards.note: 宾语和主语是同一个人或物时，宾语用反身代词。反身代词也可用来强调。

cards.title: 形式代词与不定代词
rows: 代替后面的不定式或从句
It is useful to check the map.
find 等动词后代替后面的不定式
She found it useful to check the map.
指同类中的一个，不是前面那一个
I need a pen. May I borrow one?
This pen is dry. Please give me another.
指前面提到的同一个事物
I found my pen. It was under the book.

cards.title: 辨析
rows: She saw him. / He saw her.
作主语用主格，作宾语用宾格
Her bag is here. / The bag is hers.
her 修饰名词；hers 独立使用
They saw themselves. / They saw them.
themselves 指主语本身；them 指别人
I found my pen. It works. / I need a pen. I will buy one.
it 指同一支；one 指同类的一支

items.stem: Lena has her map. _____ is reading it. Use a pronoun for Lena.
items.why: her 指明 Lena 用女性代词，主语位置用 she。

items.stem: The boys prepared the meal without help. They prepared it by _____.
items.why: by themselves 表示他们自己完成。

items.stem: Mia owns her bag. It is _____ bag.
items.why: 名词 bag 前用形容词性物主代词 her。

items.stem: _____ is useful to check the map before leaving. Use a formal subject.
items.why: it 作形式主语，真正的主语是不定式。

items.stem: The guide found _____ useful to check the map. Use a formal object.
items.why: it 作形式宾语，后面的不定式表示具体内容。

items.stem: This pen is dry. Please give me _____ pen of the same kind.
items.why: another 修饰单数名词，表示同类中的另一个。

items.stem: These notes belong to the students. The notes are _____.
items.why: theirs 独立使用，指学生们的笔记。

items.stem: I need a pen. May I borrow _____? I do not need a particular pen.
items.why: one 指同类中的一支笔。

groups.text: Nora and her classmates prepared a display of maps for their school. Nora brought a map of a walking route, and [1] placed it on the first table. Her classmates brought maps of streets and parks. One classmate, a girl, had drawn a map alone and was proud of completing it by [2]. The teacher asked the students to label the maps clearly. Nora found [3] useful to add a key explaining the symbols. The class also wanted a larger sheet of paper for a sign. Nora had one sheet, but it was too small, so she asked for [4] sheet of the same kind. A classmate found a larger sheet and gave it to her. The students put [5] names under the maps they had made. Visitors could then ask the correct student about each map. During the display, several visitors noticed a path that appeared on more than one map. The students explained that each map showed the path from a different starting point. Afterward, they stored the maps in a large folder for the next class to examine.

items.stem: [1] Nora brought a map, and _____ placed it on the table. Use a pronoun for Nora.
[2] One female classmate drew the map alone. She completed it by _____.
items.why: by herself 表示她独自完成。

items.stem: [3] Nora found _____ useful to add a key.
items.why: it 作形式宾语，真正内容是不定式。

items.stem: [4] The sheet was too small, so Nora asked for _____ sheet of the same kind.
items.why: another 指同类中的另一张。

items.stem: [5] The students put _____ names under the maps they had made.
items.why: names 前用形容词性物主代词 their，指学生们的名字。

groups.text: A group of neighbors decided to make a shared collection of recipes. One neighbor, Leo, offered to collect the recipes and arrange them in a folder. The others sent [1] their instructions on paper. Leo read each recipe and checked that the list of ingredients was complete. One page had no title, so he asked its writer to add [2]. He needed a title, but no particular wording was required. The group agreed that [3] was important to make the cooking steps clear. After preparing the folder, Leo showed it to the neighbors. They read the pages and corrected a few details without help. The folder belonged to the whole group, so it was [4] rather than Leo's alone. One neighbor copied a recipe for soup and made it at home. She then brought the soup to a meeting and explained what she had changed. The group wrote her change on a separate card, leaving the original recipe in place. The neighbors corrected the details [5]. Everyone agreed to add new recipes when they had suitable ones. The folder stayed on a shelf in the shared room for the neighbors to use.

items.stem: [1] Leo collected the recipes. The others sent _____ their instructions.
items.why: 动词 sent 后用宾格 him，指 Leo。

items.stem: [2] The page had no title. Leo asked its writer to add _____; no particular title was required. Use a pronoun.
items.why: one 指同类中的一个标题。

items.stem: [3] The group agreed that _____ was important to make the cooking steps clear.
items.why: it 作形式主语，后面不定式说明具体内容。

items.stem: [4] The folder belonged to all the neighbors. It was _____. Use a possessive pronoun.
items.why: theirs 独立使用，指邻居们共同拥有的文件夹。

items.stem: [5] The neighbors corrected the details without help. They corrected the details _____.
items.why: themselves 强调邻居们自己完成。写 by themselves，意思相同，也正确。
